title: Asymptotic linear stability of columnar vortices driven by Coriolis force
summary: In this paper, we establish the asymptotic linear stability of a class of Coriolis-driven columnar vortices for the 3-D axisymmetric Euler equations. This result represents a critical step toward proving the nonlinear asymptotic stability of such vortices. The key and widely applicable strategy is to construct a distorted Fourier basis, which is achieved by solving a two-parameter $(c, ξ)$-dependent Schrödinger equation associated with the linearized operator of the system.
